Recreate **Swamp Stack Money Tycoon**, a portrait-first browser idle tycoon. Preserve the source mechanics: start screen, initial cash/lifetime 10, lifetime unlock target 10 then x5, tier income/sec, upgrade cost growth 1.15, randomized bonus steps 10/25/50/100, randomized bonus multipliers 2/2.5/3/5/10, buy modes x1/NEXT/MAX, buy all, auto recruit, discount purchase reducing global upgrade costs by 1–5% and multiplying its next cost by 2.5, and soft feedback for unaffordable actions.

blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Swamp Stack Money Tycoon

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a browser idle tycoon/clicker. The player starts with 10 cash and 10 lifetime earnings. Pressing start reveals a HUD. Lifetime earnings unlock the first tier at 10 and each next tier target multiplies by 5. Unlocked tiers generate cash per second. Each tier can be upgraded; upgrade cost grows by 1.15 per purchased level. Bonus multiplier targets are randomized from step sizes 10/25/50/100 and multipliers 2/2.5/3/5/10. Controls include x1/NEXT/MAX buy mode, buy all, auto recruit, and a discount/exploit purchase that reduces global upgrade prices by 1–5% and multiplies its next cost by 2.5.

## Protected mechanics
- Start-to-HUD flow and running animation loop.
- Cash/lifetime/income accumulation semantics.
- Tier unlock thresholds and insertion of new businesses.
- Upgrade affordability, cost scaling, level increments, bonus multiplier thresholds.
- Buy mode behavior: x1, NEXT bonus target, MAX affordable.
- Buy All, Auto Recruit, and discount purchase semantics.
- Soft failure: blocked actions produce feedback but no loss state.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, HUD vocabulary, tier names/icons, colors, fonts, background, mascot/focal identity, toast copy, audio mappings, procedural particles, card styling, and CTA wording are safe to replace because they do not alter calculations or input semantics.

## Rebuilt premise
A cozy satirical swamp money tycoon where the Main Character Bog Baron builds bedtime bog businesses, dodges royal tax vibes through a loophole button, and compounds moon coins fr fr. It is portrait-first, one-thumb friendly, and visually owned by procedural fairycore swamp art.
